## Verdict: APPROVE with notes (issue #1440 narrowing of post_bot_commits is correct, null-safe, and coupled-site-consistent; two Important test-coverage gaps and several Suggestions remain, all below the critical verdict threshold)

## Issue Compliance
Reviewed against issue #1440 (post_bot_commits counts local-tier agent commits as human rework). The shipped jq `is_human`/`ends_bot` defs satisfy the spec: a tail non-merge commit counts only when author_login OR committer_login is a non-blank (`test("[^[:space:]]")`) string that is not `[bot]`-suffixed and not the PR author; blank/whitespace/absent/null logins classify agent-side; the type-guard makes the filter null-safe (also hardening the pre-existing `$bot_indices` anchor, which previously aborted on a null login). The coupled POSTBOT_SHAS block and the lib/cheap-gate.jq field description are updated to match. head_override=local; diffed local HEAD b9388ed7a vs merge-base of origin/main.

## Verification Checklist Results
Engine_self_modifying profile (lib/** touched) — full checklist scope. Shipped jq logic, comment accuracy vs HEAD, and coupled-block consistency verified across the Phase 3 roster with no FAIL and no INCONCLUSIVE. No documented_falsehood: all three touched doc/comment surfaces (changeset, cheap-gate.jq description, rewritten source comment) are accurate against HEAD.

## Code Review Findings
### Important / Major
1. is_human disjunction untested: every fixture sets author_login == committer_login, so `select(is_human(author) or is_human(committer))` is never exercised with a bot-author/human-committer (or the mirror) tail commit; dropping one side of the disjunction would go undetected (raised by 1/5 agents). [lib/test/run.sh ~175-191, test_gap]
2. `$l != $author` self-exclusion untested: all fixtures use PR-author `someoneelse` with human commits `alice`, so is_human's `!= $author` clause (a tail commit authored by the PR author itself yielding 0) is never exercised (raised by 1/5 agents). [lib/test/run.sh ~175-191, test_gap]
### Suggestion / Minor
1. Extraction guards confirm marker presence, not completeness — a terminator/indentation drift could over-capture past the intended close yet still pass the `case *POST_BOT_COMMITS=*` guard (corroborated: raised by 2/5 agents — silent-failure-hunter and pr-test-analyzer). [lib/test/run.sh ~152-162]
2. is_human null-safety asserted only for the anchor filter, not the tail: the null-login fixture sits before the bot anchor so it never flows through is_human's type guard (raised by 1/5 agents). [lib/test/run.sh ~181-182]
3. POSTBOT_SHAS has a single fixture; a whitespace-only or disjunction-only drift in the PBS block alone would not be caught (raised by 1/5 agents). [lib/test/run.sh ~189-190]
4. POST_BOT_COMMITS source comment (~12 lines) exceeds the prevention-only three-line ceiling with derivation/provenance narrative; trim toward the load-bearing prohibition, part may be covered by the undecidable-load-bearing carve-out (raised by 1/5 agents). [lib/fetch-pr-context.sh ~47-58, style]
5. #1440 test-purpose comment (~7 lines) exceeds the ceiling with restated behavioral narrative; keep the extraction-vs-copy prevention clause, trim the semantic restatement (raised by 1/5 agents). [lib/test/run.sh ~14113-14119, style]
6. Coupled jq prologue is duplicated byte-identically across the two blocks — maintenance note to keep them edited together (raised by 1/5 agents). [lib/fetch-pr-context.sh ~263-264]

## Verdict Criteria
No verification FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE; no self-contradicting-diff falsehood; no finding at or above the default `critical` threshold. Only below-threshold findings present -> APPROVE with notes. The two Important test_gap findings are single-source (pr-test-analyzer) and advisory-only under the Phase 4.1.5 shape-3 keying; they do not change the verdict at the critical threshold but are worth closing to guard the new predicate's untested branches.

over-grade annotation: two single-source Important findings from pr-test-analyzer flagged as shape-3 advisory (below threshold; no verdict effect).
truthfulness sweep: no finding promoted.
intra-diff contradiction scan: no contradiction found.
dirty-tree backstop: working tree clean before and after Phase 3 dispatch; no mutation finding.
